name: SLS Cancun Hotel

address.street: Boulevard Kukulcan Km 1 Zona Turistica Puerto Cancun

insider_take: This ultra-modern beachfront sanctuary brings Miami's legendary SLS sophistication to Cancun's stunning coastline, where Philippe Starck's iconic design meets pristine Caribbean waters.
whats_special: SLS Cancun is the brand's first foray into Mexico, featuring the signature Philippe Starck design aesthetic with whimsical touches throughout. The hotel sits on one of Cancun's most coveted stretches of white sand beach, while its rooftop pool offers breathtaking 360-degree views of both the Caribbean Sea and Nichupté Lagoon. The property's cutting-edge culinary program includes multiple restaurants helmed by renowned chefs, making it a true gastronomic destination.
pro_tip: Book a lagoon-view suite during full moon nights - the reflection creates an absolutely magical ambiance that's perfect for romantic occasions and makes for stunning photos.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature rooftop infinity pool at sunset, where you can witness the rare phenomenon of watching the sun set over the lagoon while the moon rises over the Caribbean. Also unmissable is the beachfront restaurant's tasting menu featuring locally-sourced Yucatecan ingredients with international flair, and the nearby Underwater Museum of Art (MUSA), just a short boat ride away.
pros: Modern luxury design with sophisticated beachfront ambiance
Prime Cancun location with direct beach access
Trendy rooftop bars and world-class dining experiences
Stylish suites with contemporary amenities and ocean views
cons: Trendy atmosphere may not suit traditional preferences
